text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Tuesday as reported by the official Algerian news agency APS. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Ghanaian President Jerry Rawlings holds talks with his Algerian counterpart Liamine Zeroual in Algiers over bilateral ties and ways to strengthen the Organisation of African Unity.
- Floods kill five people and wound seven others in the southern town of Ksar Chellala.
- Six ministers from African countries arrive in Algiers to take part in African Youth Movement congress.
